row.name: PXDesign
row.target: beta-galactosidase (1DP0 chain A) cropped to 512 residues around one fixed epitope, 80-residue binder, 592 tokens
row.note: This row is what `tt-bio design --model pxdesign` returns: the PXDesign-d generator, which writes a binder backbone with no sequence. The four-model filtering pipeline upstream runs after it (ProteinMPNN, AF2-IG and a Protenix filter) is not on the CLI. Both columns time the same three steps, featurise, generate and write the CIF, with the checkpoint load outside the cell on both sides. The LacZ crop is a cost fixture: the reference records its designs as well-folded and non-binding, because the epitope is an arbitrary exposed loop and one design per target is far below what a real campaign runs. Right fixture for seconds, wrong one for quality.

p150a.ref: Eight warm designs across two independent processes, four each, cold design dropped in both: 22.890, 22.902, 22.903, 22.918, 23.563, 23.565, 23.842, 23.912 s, pooled median 23.240. The two legs median 23.242 and 23.233, 0.04 % apart, against a within-leg spread of 4.1 % and 4.3 %. 592 tokens, 512 target residues, 80-residue binder, n_step 400 and one design per call asserted from what the call received: n_sample is backbones out of ONE trajectory, so four designs means four calls, not --num_designs 4. Every design finite, and each written CIF parses to 80 residues, 321 atoms and one chain, because write_design_cifs writes the binder alone and the C-terminal OXT is the 321st atom. The four seeds each reproduce their coordinate digest in both processes, cold round included. fp32 diffusion, the shipped default via PROTENIX_DIFFUSION_FP32_DEVICE, against the reference's bf16, an asymmetry that runs against this cell. tt-quietbox2, one Blackhole AI Processor of a p300c board, physical card 3, 11x10 Tensix grid, ttnn 0.68.0, git 283b64f3, under a benchlock hold.

split.ref: Featurisation and the CIF write, timed inside the same process as the generate step. The three leaves partition the per-design wall by construction and the recorded residual is under 0.02 s. Featurisation is 0.069 s because conditional_templ is int64 distogram bin indices at 2.8 MB, not an (NT, NT, c_z) embedding: the 65-wide table is applied on the card inside the model.

h200.ref: Cells laczc512_exte_n1_msa, laczc512_prev_n1 and laczc512_prev_n1_msa of perf/pxdesign/gpu_reference.json, the generator stage's own wall clock (gen_feat + gen_device + gen_write): 30.4243 / 30.8129 / 30.9251 s, median 30.8129, spread 1.63 %. One warm rep per cell after a discarded cold rep. The three run the same target CIF, the same hotspots and the same 80-residue binder, differing only in the eval preset and in whether the target YAML carries an msa key, which read_design_yaml documents as parsed and ignored because PXDesign-d has no trunk. A fourth cell reads 31.8163 s with LAYERNORM_TYPE=fast_layernorm exported, which the shipped CLI never sets, and is excluded; that flag is inert end to end, the two cells' whole-pipeline seconds agreeing to 0.08 %, so the 2.9 % gap in the generator stage is that stage's own run-to-run noise at one warm rep. Excluding it raises the Tenstorrent ratio, since the median of all four would be 30.8690 s. N_sample 1, n_step 400, bf16, tf32 on, checkpoint load outside the cell, torch 2.3.1 with CUDA 12.1 and cuDNN 8902 on a rented single-H200 node, the stack perf/pxdesign/gpu_reference.json records for these cells.

split.ref: gen_feat 2.083 s and gen_write 0.078 s of laczc512_exte_n1_msa, the same two host steps the Tenstorrent cell carries inside its own number.

b200.reason: Not at this protocol. The reference stack is torch 2.3.1 on CUDA 12.1 (perf/pxdesign/gpu_reference.json), and CUDA 12.1 ships no sm_100 kernels, so a B200 cannot run the thing the h200 cell measured. The pins are load-bearing in both directions: protenix needs deepspeed>=0.15.1 but 0.19.5 requires torch>=2.4, and jaxlib 0.4.29 is a local-CUDA build. Raising torch far enough to reach Blackwell moves DeepSpeed, jax and the Evoformer attention kernel with it, and the result would not be the same measurement as the H200 cell beside it.

a100.ref: The generator stage's own wall clock (gen_feat + gen_device + gen_write), the same quantity the h200 cell publishes: 44.9314 / 45.1740 / 45.5274 s, median 45.1740, spread 1.32 %. Three fresh processes of one cell, each a discarded cold rep 0 plus one warm rep 1, so every sample is rep-1-of-a-fresh-process as each h200 cell's was. The h200 median pools three cells that differ only in eval preset and in whether the YAML carries an msa key, which read_design_yaml parses and ignores because PXDesign-d has no trunk; two of those need a sliced MSA that is an external MSA-server product and is not in the repo, so this arm repeats the one cell it can byte-match instead, the same target YAML sha256 48a6b5c0c5d9ca9b the h200 laczc512_prev_n1 cell records. The A100 runs this stage 46.61 % slower than the H200's 30.8129 s, and its spread is the tighter of the two (1.32 % against the h200 cell's 1.63 % over the three it pools). Inside it, 41.5474 s is the diffusion call at 84.1 % mean GPU utilisation and 250 W median, and 3.5186 s plus 0.1080 s are the host featurise and CIF write the h200 cell also carries inside its number. Read only this stage against the H200. The whole pipeline is 153.7 s here against 112.4 s on the H200, and that wall is not this cell: the rest of it is the ProteinMPNN and AF2-IG filtering subprocesses (11.6 s of ProteinMPNN against 8.6 s, 65.5 s of AF2-IG against 49.8 s), which the CLI does not run at all. Reproducible: all 3 processes return the identical designed sequence at seed 42 (EPSPEEVIARLRAAVAALEARVAELMAKASPEERARLERLLEYLRARVARLVAGVEAGDPEALEAARRLVRRLEATLAAL), and each written CIF parses to one design of an 80-residue binder with no non-finite coordinates. The DeepSpeed Evoformer kernel is present and fast LayerNorm is not reached in any rep, matching the h200 cells the page includes rather than the fast-LayerNorm one it excludes. Card exclusive, no compute app on it before any rep. NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, driver 580.159.03, compute capability 8.0 against the H200's 9.0. Peak allocated VRAM 2.078 GiB against the h200 cell's 2.078 GiB. Stack byte-matched to the h200 cell's: torch 2.3.1 with CUDA 12.1 and cuDNN 8902, protenix 0.5.0+pxd, pxdesign 0.1.0, pxdbench 0.1.2, deepspeed 0.15.4, jax 0.4.29, numpy 1.26.3. N_sample 1, n_step 400, bf16, 512 target residues, 80-residue binder, checkpoint load outside the cell.
